Name: Focus Volume
Description: Adjusts the volume of the application that is currently in focus, instead of the system volume.

com.hotspot.focusvolume.action.Name: Focus Volume
com.hotspot.focusvolume.action.Tooltip: Rotate the knob to change the volume of the app in focus. Press to mute.

com.hotspot.focusvolume.info.Name: Active Window
com.hotspot.focusvolume.info.Tooltip: Shows the active window and the app whose volume is being changed.
